categories.title: Working Instance Lifecycle
categories.summary: Make generated Mole instances easier to validate, compare with source, and upgrade conservatively.
categories.priority_notes: This aligns with the current product goal of making working instances credible beyond initial scaffolding.

categories.title: Command Surface
categories.summary: Make outcome-oriented Mole commands more consistent and useful without overbuilding the backend.
categories.priority_notes: This supports adoption, but follows the instance lifecycle work.

categories.title: Team Collaboration
categories.summary: Make Mole safer and clearer for teams using shared cloud-synced folders as a local file system.
categories.priority_notes: This is the next active category because previous PRD categories are complete and team shared-folder use is a likely adoption path.

categories.title: Molehill Metrics
categories.summary: Add lightweight local metrics for processed inbox items so Mole workspaces can show daily, weekly, and monthly processing activity without hosted analytics.
categories.priority_notes: This builds on the completed inbox processing lock and receipt workflow, keeps the local-first architecture, and improves confidence that teams are feeding the mole consistently.

categories.title: Stable source IDs and archive-safe provenance
categories.summary: Give captured and imported sources stable IDs, move-safe provenance, correction history, and safe migration from path-only references.
categories.priority_notes: Approved from issue #23. This is a prerequisite for source-aware validation, travel-log records, shared-folder processing, and ID-based metrics.

tasks.title: Add the versioned source record schema and registry primitives
acceptance: New records use immutable src_ UUID identities and exact-byte SHA-256 hashes.
Records validate, persist one per source, and preserve path and content history.
Resolver, reconcile, correction, attachment, duplicate, conflict, and workspace-boundary behavior have focused tests.

tasks.title: Integrate registration with CLI and UI capture and add source lifecycle commands
acceptance: CLI and UI captures return and embed source IDs.
Existing files and attachments can be registered without changing their bytes.
Move resolution, reconciliation, and explicit correction are observable through CLI output.

tasks.title: Add ID-bearing references with backward-compatible receipt and metrics readers
acceptance: New evidence, context, receipts, audit, and metrics use source IDs with optional paths.
Legacy path-only receipts remain readable and moved sources are not double-counted by path alone.
Focused tests cover old and new receipt shapes and reference serialization.

tasks.title: Classify legacy path references and report duplicates and conflicts
acceptance: Dry-run migration classifies references as resolved, ambiguous, or unresolved.
Apply mode changes only resolved structured references and writes an audit report.
Duplicate, conflict, orphan, traversal, and symlink findings are actionable and never silently merged.

tasks.title: Ship workspace guidance, templates, fixtures, and full validation
acceptance: New workspaces include the schema, registry guidance, and ownership rules.
Docs explain source references, migration, security, and commands.
Root npm test and command checks cover the approved acceptance criteria.
